chunks: Ali ibn Isa (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Muhammad Majiluwayh narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Sulami, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon the Prophet (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) and said: O Muhammad! As-Salam (God) conveys the greeting to you and says: 'I created the seven heavens and all that is in them, and the seven earths and all that is upon them. I did not create a place more magnificent than the Rukn and the Maqam. Yet if a servant were to supplicate to Me there from the moment I created the heavens and the earths, and then were to meet Me as a rejector of the wilaya of Ali, I would cast him headlong into Saqar.'

key_terms.الركن: The Rukn — the corner of the Ka'ba containing the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad), considered the most sacred single point within the Ka'ba
key_terms.السلام يقرئك السلام: As-Salam (one of the Beautiful Names of God, meaning 'The Source of Peace') conveys greetings — a distinctive divine salutation formula
key_terms.المقام: The Maqam — Maqam Ibrahim, the Station of Ibrahim, where Ibrahim (AS) stood while building the Ka'ba; its mark is preserved in a stone
key_terms.الولاية: Wilaya — divinely-appointed guardianship and authority; in this Shia context it refers specifically to the authority of Imam Ali (AS) as the rightful successor to the Prophet
key_terms.سقر: Saqar — one of the names/levels of Hellfire in the Quran (74:26-27), signifying severe punishment

ai.seo_question: What did Gabriel tell the Prophet about rejecting the wilaya of Ali ibn Abi Talib?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a divine message conveyed via Gabriel to the Prophet Muhammad, declaring that the Rukn (the corner of the Ka'ba containing the Black Stone) and the Maqam (the Station of Ibrahim) are the most sacred spots in all creation. Despite the immense spiritual merit of constant worship at these holiest of sites, God warns that rejecting the wilaya (divinely-appointed authority/guardianship) of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib would nullify all such worship, condemning the rejector to Saqar (Hell). This reflects the central Shia theological position that wilayah is the foundational condition upon which all other deeds are evaluated.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. `Isa (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Muhammad Majiluwayh narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid al-Barqi narrated to us from Muhammad b. Hassan al-Salami from Muhammad b. Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:

Gabriel (as) came down to the Prophet (sw) and said: O Muhammad! Peace (God) recites the salaam to you and says: “I created the seven heavens and that which is in them, and the seven Earths and that which is upon them. I did not create a place that is greater than the rukn and the maqam. If a worshiper supplicates to Me there from when I created the heavens and the Earths, then meets Me as a rejector of the wilaya of `Ali, I will throw him into Hellfire.”
